input_messages.content: Hi! I recently bought a digital camera from your store, but it doesn’t zoom in as much as I was hoping. I use it mainly for bird-watching, so I really need something with the highest possible zoom. I’d like to exchange it for a model with the maximum zoom you have, but I want all the other features to stay the same. Can you help me with this? I’d like to get this sorted out as quickly as possible.
Sure, my name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. I actually don’t remember which email I used for the order—will my name and zip code be enough to find my account?

I don’t have the order ID handy right now. Is there another way you can look up my order, maybe by the date of purchase or the shipping address? Let me know what info you need and I’ll do my best to provide it.
I ordered the camera about two weeks ago, and it was shipped to my home address in San Antonio, 78260. If you need the full address, let me know. Does that help narrow it down?
Yes, that’s correct—I want to exchange the camera from order #W4689314. Please keep all the other features the same, but I want the zoom to be as high as possible. Thank you for helping me with this!

Yes, I’d like to exchange my current camera for the 10x zoom variant you mentioned, with the same resolution and storage type. For any additional payment or refund, I’d prefer to use my PayPal account instead of the Mastercard. Please let me know what the next steps are!
Yes, that’s all correct. Please go ahead and process the exchange for the 10x zoom, 30MP camera, and use my PayPal account for any payment or refund. Thank you for your help!

Thank you so much for your help! I’ll keep an eye out for the return instructions. That’s all I needed for now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
